source.generationPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: early VRChat clothing product design reference and appearance-gate review. Create a clean, production-oriented front-and-back concept sheet for an original outfit called Moonlit Patisserie Uniform for a VRChat avatar. Show the same adult feminine anime fashion mannequin twice, full-body, front view on the left and back view on the right, standing in a neutral A-pose with arms slightly away from the torso. Use a simple light warm-gray studio background. Garment: a fitted ivory short-sleeve blouse with a modest high rounded collar and gently puffed sleeves; a separate deep cocoa cropped vest with simple front buttons and clean panel seams; a high-waisted plum A-line skirt ending at the knees; and a separate pale champagne waist apron with a clean rectangular bib, straight shoulder straps, and a softly curved lower edge. Keep each garment layer clearly separate and easy to interpret as sewn pieces. Use restrained piping and a small crescent-shaped fabric patch on the apron only. Style: polished fashion concept illustration with realistic cloth construction and clear seam placement, crisp but not photoreal. Framing: front and back views equal size, full head-to-shoe visible, no perspective distortion, no overlap between views. Lighting: soft even studio lighting. Materials: matte woven blouse and skirt, soft suiting for the vest, light cotton apron. Constraints: one outfit design shown in both views; readable silhouette, modest fit, visible sleeves, distinct vest and skirt, apron follows the waist, hem at the knee. Avoid logos, lettering, watermark, props, extra clothing layers, dramatic poses, cropped body parts, transparent fabric, shiny latex, armor, and extra views.
